title: Việt Sử Era
description: One historical era of Việt Sử. Content is data, not code — every historian-authored string, citation and asset reference lives here, never in Dart. Vietnamese (vi) is canonical and required with full diacritics; English (en) is an optional toggle.

id.description: Stable unique id for the era.

slug.description: URL/asset-safe kebab-case key. Also the base filename.

order.description: Position in the vertical era stack / global timeline (0-based).

period.description: Id of the dynasty / period this era belongs to (see content/periods.json). The dynasty hub groups eras under their period.

flagship.description: Marks this era as a rare "peak" — a high point of the chronicle given a distinguished UI treatment (a badge and warmer aura on Home, a dominant node on the global timeline). Optional; defaults to false. Reserve for a handful of true peaks.

kicker.description: Eyebrow above the hero, e.g. "Kỷ nguyên khởi thủy".

subtitle.description: Italic chronicle tagline, e.g. "Buổi bình minh dựng nước.".

overview.description: Editorial intro paragraph for the Era Hub — a chronicle-grounded framing of the era. Optional.

startYear.description: Numeric start for sorting/scrubbing. Negative = BCE (TCN).

palette.description: Era colour identity. Drives VSEraPalette; the app derives the sơn mài scene from the accent.

scene.description: Optional explicit scene gradient stops (top → bottom). Omit to derive from accent.
Parallax layer slots (back → front). Placeholder gradients now; real sơn mài PNGs/Rive drop in later.

primarySource.description: The single chronicle this era is drawn from (the grant's single-source rule).

characters.description: This era's roster: references into content/people.json by `ref`, each with optional per-era overrides (a figure's name/role/look can differ by era, but it is still one person). Events reference them by that same `ref` id via `figureIds`.

draft.description: true while an era is still being authored in the CMS. Must still be a fully valid era (schema + referential integrity) to commit, but tool/build_content_pack.dart excludes it from the published content pack — installed apps, old versions included, never receive it over the air. It still ships in a fresh app *build*, since assets/content is bundled from content/ verbatim (see EXECUTION.md's Cycle H). Omit (or false) once the era is ready to publish.

localizedText.description: Localized string. vi is canonical and required; en is an optional toggle.

citation.description: A visible source citation. Rendered on every event — a feature, not fine print.

work.description: Title of the chronicle/work, e.g. "Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư".

section.description: Locus within the work, e.g. "Ngoại kỷ · Quyển 1".

display.description: Label as shown, e.g. "≈ 2879 TCN", "Huyền sử".

value.description: Numeric year for sorting/placement. Negative = BCE (TCN). null for pure legend with no fixed date.

approximate.description: True when the date is circa (≈).

assetRef.description: A tier-aware asset. flagship may be Rive/animated; reduced is the static fallback; placeholder names a built-in stand-in (e.g. era gradient) until real art lands.

video.description: Optional looping video source (e.g. an animated cover mp4). Played on flagship where supported; reduced/flagship image remains the fallback.

body.description: Long-form event text for the detail screen.

details.description: Fuller account revealed under "read more", drawn from the chronicle.

relatedEventIds.description: Ids of other events in this era that relate to this one.

figureIds.description: Ids (into the era's `characters`) of the figures appearing in this event.

characterRef.description: A reference to a person in content/people.json, with optional per-era overrides. `ref` is the person id (also what `figureIds` use); any of name/epithet/bio/portrait/avatar/fullBody override the canonical value for this era only.

ref.description: Id of a person in content/people.json.
